This PR changes Control UI route definitions and page metadata so most Settings pages generate `/settings/*` canonical URLs while retaining legacy top-level aliases.

PR surface: Source +4, Tests +31. Total +35 across 7 files.

Reproducibility: not applicable. this is a user-visible routing feature, not a reported bug. Source review verifies the route mapping and current-main Settings membership rather than a failing current-main reproduction path.

target.title: improve(ui): nest Settings pages under /settings routes
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

In the pre-change routing model, Control UI Settings pages live at several top-level URLs, so Settings navigation does not have a single canonical URL namespace. This PR proposes `/settings/*` as the canonical Settings route family while preserving existing top-level deep links.

## Why This Change Was Made

In this PR, Settings route metadata points navigation and programmatic route generation at `/settings/general`, `/settings/appearance`, and the rest of the `/settings/*` pages. Existing top-level paths such as `/config`, `/appearance`, `/channels`, `/debug`, and `/logs` remain registered as aliases so old links still resolve to the same route ids.

This intentionally does not change Settings layout, sidebar structure, visual styling, form placement, or content organization.

## User Impact

In this PR, Settings URLs are canonicalized under `/settings/*`; existing bookmarks and direct links to the older top-level Settings paths continue to work.

## Screenshots

Desktop `/settings/general` in this PR:

![Desktop Settings route](https://graceful-linden-paht.here.now/pr-100928-settings-routing-desktop.png)

Mobile `/settings/general` in this PR:

![Mobile Settings route](https://graceful-linden-paht.here.now/pr-100928-settings-routing-mobile.png)

## Evidence

Validated locally:

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs ui/src/app-navigation.test.ts ui/src/app-navigation-groups.test.ts`
- `pnpm exec oxfmt --check --threads=1 ui/src/app-route-paths.ts ui/src/pages/config/route.ts ui/src/pages/channels/route.ts ui/src/pages/debug/route.ts ui/src/pages/logs/route.ts ui/src/app-navigation.test.ts ui/src/app-navigation-groups.test.ts`
- `git diff --check HEAD~1..HEAD`
- Route resolver smoke: `/settings/general -> config`, `/settings/appearance -> appearance`, `/appearance -> appearance`
- Screenshot capture: desktop and mobile `/settings/general` via the mock Control UI dev server

Skipped by request: local `codex /review` and autoreview.
